summary: All 8 acceptance criteria exercised via browser checks (no API-bearing criteria; site is a static, frontend-only data-driven app with no backend logic tied to any criterion). 8 passed, 0 failed.

checks.criterion: Explore Destinations hover menu remains open while moving the pointer from the nav label into the menu
checks.name: nav-mega-menu-hover-bridge
checks.evidence: Hovered nav-explore-destinations-button, moved mouse across bridge into mega-menu-japan-link, menu stayed visible, click navigated to /destinations/japan.

checks.criterion: Homepage duration filter changes journey results
checks.name: home-duration-filter-updates-results
checks.evidence: filter-duration=10+ Days shows 'Japan, in detail' and 'The Open Horizon', hides 'Bali Escape' (count 0); filter-duration=3-5 Days shows 'A City in a Garden' (Singapore).

checks.criterion: All listed destinations have detailed itineraries
checks.name: destinations-have-itinerary-sections
checks.evidence: Visited dubai, japan, switzerland, kashmir, kerala, rajasthan, goa, thailand, malaysia, maldives, italy, singapore, phu-quoc, turkey, australia -- each rendered itineraries-section with 'Choose your journey' heading and itinerary-timeline. Bali confirmed to render itinerary-options with count=3 (Bali Escape, Bali Highlights, Bali & Nusa Penida).

checks.name: bali-itinerary-interaction
checks.evidence: On /destinations/bali, selected 2nd itinerary option (updates overview), clicked itinerary-day-toggle-02: aria-expanded flipped false->true and itinerary-day-02 content became visible.

checks.name: homepage-visual-refinement
checks.evidence: Screenshots confirm cinematic full-bleed hero with strong serif type hierarchy, square-edged image-led destination cards, and a premium dark editorial 'Why Tentwood' section (dark teal bg, portrait image, numbered list).

checks.name: navbar-sticky-transition
checks.evidence: At scrollY=0 navbar class includes transparent gradient 'from-black/35'; after scrollTo(0,900) navbar class switches to solid 'bg-[#0b6972]/95' with shadow/backdrop-blur.

checks.name: floating-whatsapp-visible-with-ctas
checks.evidence: On /destinations/japan, floating-whatsapp-button ('Tentwood concierge / Begin on WhatsApp') visible and destination-request-button visible+enabled simultaneously, not obscured.

checks.name: scroll-restoration-on-route-change
checks.evidence: Scrolled homepage to scrollY>1000, clicked Bali link (visa-free rail, a[href='/destinations/bali']), landed on /destinations/bali with scrollY<50.

action_items: No backend test artifacts were created: server.py exposes only a generic /api/ health route and a stub status-check model; none of the 8 acceptance criteria depend on any API/DB behavior -- all data (journeys, itineraries, destinations) is static TS data bundled into the frontend.
